summary: A social media post alleged that a victim lost approximately 189 SOL after handing an unlocked phone to a stranger in a nightclub. The phone remained unlocked for several minutes before an unauthorized transfer emptied the wallet.
user_mistake: Handed an unlocked device containing a cryptocurrency wallet to an untrusted person
prevention: Never give an unlocked device to strangers / Protect wallet devices with biometrics, automatic screen lock, and separate long-term holdings from everyday devices
